<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_ws_operation"><sys_ws_operation action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><active>true</active><consumes/><consumes_customized>false</consumes_customized><default_operation_uri/><enforce_acl/><http_method>GET</http_method><name>List Stories For Project</name><operation_script><![CDATA[(function process(request, response) {
    try {
        var number = request.pathParams.number;

        if (gs.nil(number)) {
            response.setStatus(400);
            response.setBody({
                error: 'Missing required parameter: number'
            });
            return;
        }

        var limit = request.queryParams.limit;
        var offset = request.queryParams.offset;

        var service = new ProjectMCPStoryService();

        var result = service.listForProject(number, {
            limit: limit,
            offset: offset
        });

        if (!result.success) {
            response.setStatus(result.status || 500);

            gs.error(
                'project.story.list service error: ' +
                result.error
            );

            response.setBody({
                error: 'Request failed. See server logs for details.'
            });
            return;
        }

        response.setStatus(200);
        response.setBody(result.data);

    } catch (e) {
        gs.error(
            'project.story.list error: ' +
            e.message
        );

        response.setStatus(500);
        response.setBody({
            error: 'Internal error processing request'
        });
    }
})(request, response);]]></operation_script><operation_uri/><produces/><produces_customized>false</produces_customized><relative_path>/project/{number}/stories</relative_path><request_example/><requires_acl_authorization>true</requires_acl_authorization><requires_authentication>true</requires_authentication><requires_snc_internal_role>true</requires_snc_internal_role><short_description/><support_trailing_slash>false</support_trailing_slash><sys_class_name>sys_ws_operation</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>MCPAdmin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-10-03 16:18:41</sys_created_on><sys_id>13bbeb8c2bf3471035a8f22ffe91bf33</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>List Stories For Project</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Project MCP Server" source="x_snc_project_mc_0">51aed7e62bef4b10ff25f5bc4e91bf6b</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Project MCP Server">51aed7e62bef4b10ff25f5bc4e91bf6b</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_ws_operation_13bbeb8c2bf3471035a8f22ffe91bf33</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>MCPAdmin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-10-03 16:18:41</sys_updated_on><web_service_definition/><web_service_version/></sys_ws_operation></record_update>
